name: clerk
title: Clerk
description: Clerk as the auth strategy: server session facade, client hooks, provider, request proxy with Clerk's middleware, prebuilt sign-in/sign-up/user-button components, and the strategy dispatch in the shared auth files.

files.content:
/**
 * Clerk provider, picked up by scripts/generate-providers.ts.
 *
 * Wraps the app in `ClerkProvider` only when `AUTH_STRATEGY=clerk` and both
 * Clerk keys are set; otherwise it renders children unchanged, so installing
 * the `clerk` registry item changes nothing until the strategy is switched on.
 */
export { default } from "@/components/modules/auth/clerk-provider";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"; export default function BadgeClerk({ className, children, }: { className?: string; children?: React.ReactNode; }) { return ( {children} ); }

docs: Clerk (hosted, paid) as the app's auth strategy. Create an application at https://dashboard.clerk.com and copy the publishable and secret keys from API Keys into `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` and `CLERK_SECRET_KEY` (`CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET` from Webhooks, if you add one). `AUTH_STRATEGY=clerk` turns it on; the keys alone do nothing, and Clerk is never picked automatically (Better Auth stays the default). `src/env.ts` must accept `"clerk"` in its `AUTH_STRATEGY` enum (Bones has it from shipkit-io/bones#107). Once on: `auth()`, `signIn()` and `signOut()` from `@/server/auth` and `useSession()` from `@/lib/auth/use-session` read Clerk, `src/config/providers/clerk.provider.tsx` mounts `ClerkProvider`, and `src/proxy.ts` runs `clerkMiddleware()` and forwards `/sign-in` and `/sign-up` to Clerk's hosted Account Portal (`next` becomes the return URL; a signed-in visitor goes to the dashboard). Set `publicMetadata.role` to `admin` on a user in the dashboard to make them an admin. Overwrites the Bones stubs `src/server/clerk/facade.ts` and `src/lib/auth/clerk-client.ts`, and the shared `auth-strategy.ts`, `session-mapping.ts`, `use-session.ts` and `server/auth.ts` (same content Bones ships). Not on: the proxy is a pass-through and the provider renders children unchanged.
